messages.subject: Alignement error
parts:
Hello,

This is the first time I use subread and I have got a problem. 
In fact, I tried to align reads to reference genes by creating an index and using it (see the requests below), but the index built doesn't seem to be usable when I use the "subread-align" command.
Can you give a look to the commands I used and the answer in the attachment file, please? I certainly made a mistake somewhere.

Thank you,
Jason


Requests:
        //The index was built with this command:
        subread-buildindex -o index reference_genes.faa
//subread created the index file: "subread-index-sam-002605-fsxAxd" that I used to make the alignment:
subread-align -i subread-index-sam-002605-fsxAxd -r pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R1_001.fastq -R pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R2_001.fastq -o solution.sam -t 0

//As it didn't work, I also tried these commands but nothing worked as well:
subread-align -i ~/Bureau/subread-index-sam-002605-fsxAxd -r pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R1_001.fastq -R pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R2_001.fastq -o solution.sam -t 0


subread-align -i ./subread-index-sam-002605-fsxAxd -r pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R1_001.fastq -R pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R2_001.fastq -o solution.sam -t 0


subread-align -i ~/Bureau/subread-index-sam-002605-fsxAxd -r pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R1_001.fastq -R pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R2_001.fastq -o solution.sam -t 0


subread-align -i ./index -r pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R1_001.fastq -R pc24-1_TGACCA_L001_R2_001.fastq -o solution.sam -t 0
